title: aiomfac-surrogates: reproducibility material for "Neural-network surrogates for AIOMFAC" (Parts 1 and 2)
description: Notebooks, data, trained networks and results that reproduce the tables and figures of the two-part paper series Neural-network surrogates for AIOMFAC: Part 1, binary water–organic activity coefficients, molecular representation and data scale; Part 2, aqueous electrolyte mixtures and organic–electrolyte coupling. All AIOMFAC calls use aiomfac_py, a pure-Python port of the AIOMFAC model. Version 2.0.0 accompanies the revised manuscripts; see CHANGELOG.md.
